tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 5b (transaction filters, search, and templates) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 5) and spec.md (Transactions & Budgeting) first. Phase 5a already built transaction entry/edit + splits + reconciliation; this task (5b) adds discovery (filters + search), quick-entry templates, and finishes a carried-over follow-up. Reuse existing layers: src/lib/transactions/ (splitSum, isSplitBalanced), src/lib/db/ (MonetaFoxDB, createRepositories, Repositories, models, EncryptedTable), src/stores/transactionStore.ts, src/lib/accounts/ (accountBalance, netWorthInBase), src/lib/currency/ (formatCurrency), src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx, src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx.

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): amounts are SIGNED; a filter matching a category matches BOTH tx.categoryId AND any split's categoryId; categoryTotals allocates split lines to their own categories and non-split amounts to the transaction's category (a transaction with no categoryId creates no bucket); the account balance is driven by the parent amount (unchanged from 5a).

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/transactions/** (extend), src/lib/db/models.ts (ADD a TransactionTemplate interface only), src/lib/db/database.ts (ADD a transactionTemplates table via a NEW version(2) migration — keep version(1) intact; do not change existing tables), src/lib/db/repository.ts (ADD a transactionTemplates repository), src/stores/transactionStore.ts (filter state + template actions), src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx (filter/search/template UI), src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx (the carried follow-up below), and new src/components/transactions/** files. Do NOT modify crypto/auth, other stores, other db tables, routes, App.tsx, .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE:
1. Extend src/lib/transactions/index.ts (pure, well-tested):
   - export interface TransactionFilter { accountId?: string; dateFrom?: string; dateTo?: string; categoryId?: string; payee?: string; cleared?: boolean; reconciled?: boolean; tags?: string[] }
   - export function filterTransactions(txns: Transaction[], f: TransactionFilter): Transaction[] — date range inclusive on the ISO date string; accountId exact; categoryId matches tx.categoryId OR any split.categoryId; payee is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING match; cleared/reconciled exact when provided; tags means the transaction contains ALL given tags; an empty filter returns all.
   - export function searchTransactions(txns: Transaction[], query: string): Transaction[] — case-insensitive match over payee, notes, and tags; an empty/whitespace query returns all.
   - export function categoryTotals(txns: Transaction[]): Record<string, number> — for each transaction, add each split line's amount to its categoryId, or (no splits) add the amount to tx.categoryId; skip transactions with no category and never create an empty-string bucket.
2. src/lib/db/models.ts — add interface TransactionTemplate { id: string; name: string; accountId?: string; payee?: string; amount?: number; currency?: string; categoryId?: string; notes?: string; tags?: string[]; splits?: TransactionSplit[] }.
3. src/lib/db/database.ts — add a transactionTemplates table with a NEW this.version(2).stores({ transactionTemplates: '&id' }) migration that preserves all version(1) tables; declare the Dexie.Table field. Add a short comment on how future migrations chain.
4. src/lib/db/repository.ts — add transactionTemplates: EncryptedTable<TransactionTemplate> to Repositories and to createRepositories.
5. src/stores/transactionStore.ts — hold current filter/search state and expose derived filtered results (use the pure functions); template actions: saveAsTemplate(fromTransaction), listTemplates, applyTemplate(templateId) (prefills a new entry), deleteTemplate. Delegate persistence to repositories.transactionTemplates.
6. src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx — add a filter bar (date range, account, category, payee, cleared/reconciled) and a search box that drive the visible list via the store; add template quick-entry: save the current transaction as a template, and a picker to start a new entry from a template.
7. src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx — CARRIED-OVER 5a FOLLOW-UP: feed the loaded transactions into accountBalance / netWorthInBase so account balances and net worth reflect real activity (they currently show opening balance only). Keep the page structure.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root): `corepack pnpm run typecheck`; run `corepack pnpm run test` at least twice (must be green both times — the suite is deterministic, keep it so); `corepack pnpm run lint`; `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. Write real Vitest tests for the new functions, the templates repository, and the store.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the filter/search/category-totals semantics, the v2 migration, and how AccountsPage balances now include transactions.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + semantics exactly; the v2 migration must be additive and preserve v1 data; category filter matches split categories; reuse existing layers; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (filterTransactions incl. split-category + date range + payee substring + cleared; searchTransactions; categoryTotals respecting splits; and a transactionTemplates encrypted round-trip proving the Dexie v2 migration). The query functions, TransactionTemplate model, v2 table + repo, and the filter/search/template UI exist; AccountsPage now uses transactions in balances. The Phase 5a/4/3a/1 contract tests still pass; the suite is green across two consecutive runs; typecheck + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
